title: Feedback
intro: Spotted a bug? Wish the board did something new? Tell us — it goes straight to the family's fix-it list.

notConfigured.title: Feedback isn't set up yet
notConfigured.body: Ask a parent to connect GitHub under {path}. Once that's done, anything you send here lands on the family's to-fix list.

kinds.bugBlurb: A page errors, a button does nothing, the numbers look wrong…
kinds.featureBlurb: Something the board should do, or do better.

form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholderBug: e.g. Chore board shows yesterday's chores
form.titlePlaceholderFeature: e.g. Birthday countdowns on the dashboard
form.bodyPlaceholderBug: What were you doing, what happened, and what did you expect instead?
form.bodyPlaceholderFeature: What should the board do? Who in the family would use it?
form.includeDiagnosticsHelp: Adds your browser and window size to the report — helps track it down.

sent.title: Sent! Issue #{number}
sent.body: Thanks — it's on the list now.

errors.notConnectedBody: Ask a parent to connect it under Settings → Feedback.
errors.rejectedBody: {reason} — your words aren't lost, try again in a bit.

settings.title: Feedback → GitHub
settings.intro: Bug reports and ideas from the {link} become GitHub issues on your repo — no GitHub accounts needed for the family. Create a {tokenLink} with Issues read & write on just that one repo.
settings.repoHelp: owner/repo — where the issues get filed.
settings.tokenHelp: Stored on your server, never shown again.
settings.tokenHelpStored: Stored on your server, never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current token.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect GitHub? The saved token is deleted and family members can no longer send feedback.

errors.needsSetup: Save a repo and token first
